tool.title: Tools viewer
tool.description: Render this layer's Tool nodes, and the skills each satisfies, as one page.

inputs.name: check
inputs.description: Fail if a page is stale, instead of writing.

inputs.name: site
inputs.description: A site being built: write the pages at their declared route under it instead of under the harness's own site directory. A repository's own site build passes it (the tools layer's `visualiser-writers.ts`), since its harness docs are a pinned mount.

inputs.name: scope
inputs.description: A scoped site build: the comma-separated instances whose per-layer Tools pages this writer writes; every other layer's Tools pages are linked on the platform's site, not copied (owner, 2026-11-13: "other harnesses should be referenced not included"). The combined index and API documents are still written. Passed by the tools layer's `visualiser-writers.ts`. Absent: every instance.

outputs.name: pages
outputs.description: The viewer pages, under the published site directory.

$comment.comment: A viewer generator (`viewerTool` in `../lib.ts` holds the ports every viewer shares).
